LEGAL SUMMARY:

The case is listed in the Court of the Junior Civil Judge at Chennur, with the case number No. 165 of 1998. The parties involved are the State of Telangana, represented by the Sub-Inspector of Police, Kotapally (Complainant), and Tallapalli Sagar (Accused). 

A docket order was issued on 07.03.2018, by the Hon'ble District and Session Judge Adilabad, under O.M.Dis.No. 1099/2018/crl, permitting the entry of the case in the LPC (Local Police Court) Register.

The case was recorded under the jurisdiction of the Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, and was given under the hand and seal of that Judge on the 13th day of March, 2018.

No other facts, dates, names, or statutory provisions are provided in the evidence. All information is derived directly from the supplied documents.
